question: Should the additive `model-session-runtime` and `interactive-runtime` exports become the supported long-lived plugin API for future channel model pickers?
rationale: The implementation is behavior-neutral for existing channels, but exposing these contracts defines the extension boundary that future plugins will rely on; that API direction needs maintainer acceptance rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Accept the SDK seam
options.body: Merge the additive exports as the supported contract and require later channel integrations to opt in through their declared capability profile.

options.title: Keep the service internal for now
options.body: Remove the plugin SDK exports and revisit the public picker contract when the first channel migration provides a concrete external consumer.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK seam
recommendation.body: Merge the additive exports as the supported contract and require later channel integrations to opt in through their declared capability profile.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR context states that the API direction was settled for this phase, and this contributor authored the current model-picker contract series.
